title: Nonhalting at every earlier time
statement: Let $H$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet and state set $B$, and let $c$ be a configuration on a finite Boolean input word. If the configuration reached from $c$ after $t$ steps has state $q_f$, then for every integer $j$ with $0\le j\le t$, the configuration reached after $j$ steps has some state.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is a multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols and state set $B$
